title: PinSieve: Production Selective VLM Serving and a Governed Memory Flywheel for Enterprise Content-Quality Triage
abstract: arXiv:2608.24040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise AI agents in production often need to be bounded, stateful, observable, and governable rather than fully autonomous. We present PinSieve, a production case study in a large-scale content-quality pipeline. Its deployed component is a selective vision-language-model (VLM) Serving Agent that operates only on the grey-zone slice left unresolved by lightweight upstream models, exposes a scalar routing score online, and preserves controlled human escalation. On this slice, the deployed system filters 2.05x more non-actionable items than the previous production module while slightly reducing estimated miss rate; after promotion, it improves review productivity by 25.7%, reduces normalized operating cost by 16.2%, and moves signal delivery from next-day to same-day. We then study maintenance through a governed memory flywheel under selective feedback, where escalated items are reviewed by default and auto-passed items are labeled main

translated_title: PinSieve：面向企业内容质量分诊的生产级选择性VLM服务与受治理的记忆飞轮
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24040v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：生产环境中的企业AI代理通常需要具备受限性、有状态性、可观察性和可治理性，而非完全自主。我们介绍了PinSieve，这是一个在大规模内容质量管道中的生产案例研究。其部署组件是一个选择性视觉语言模型（VLM）服务代理，仅处理由轻量级上游模型遗留的灰色地带切片，在线提供标量路由分数，并保留受控的人工升级机制。在该切片上，部署系统比先前生产模块过滤了2.05倍更多的不可操作项，同时略微降低了估计漏检率；推广后，审查生产力提高了25.7%，标准化运营成本降低了16.2%，信号传递从次日提升至当日。随后，我们通过受治理的记忆飞轮在选择性反馈下研究维护，其中升级项默认审查，自动通过项则被标记为主流。
tldr: PinSieve通过选择性VLM服务仅处理灰色地带内容，结合受治理记忆飞轮，在降低漏检率的同时显著提升审查效率和降低成本，实现了从次日到当日的信号传递。
en_tdlr: PinSieve enhances enterprise content triage by selectively applying VLM services to grey-zone items with a governed memory flywheel, boosting review productivity by 25.7% and cutting costs by 16.2% while enabling same-day signal delivery.
